[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pomodoro-timer"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "A modern, native macOS Pomodoro timer with a distraction-focused blue/green design."
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "L3monKenji" }]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "PySide6>=6.6",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.0",
]
package = [
    "pyinstaller>=6.11",
]

[project.scripts]
pomodoro = "pomodoro.cli:main"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/l3montree-dev/pomodoro"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
---
/workspace/docker:
entrypoint.sh

/workspace/packaging:
Pomodoro.spec
build.sh
make_icon.py
pomodoro_app.py

/workspace/sounds:
README.md

/workspace/src:
pomodoro

/workspace/src/pomodoro:
__init__.py
__main__.py
audio
cli.py
core
gui
persistence

/workspace/src/pomodoro/audio:
__init__.py
notifications.py
player.py

/workspace/src/pomodoro/core:
__init__.py
timer.py

/workspace/src/pomodoro/gui:
__init__.py
app.py
confetti.py
main_window.py
stats_view.py
theme.py
timer_view.py
widgets.py

/workspace/src/pomodoro/persistence:
__init__.py
history.py
paths.py
settings.py

/workspace/tests:
__init__.py
test_paths.py
test_timer.py
